heading: What the measurement shows

ph.what: pH describes how acidic or alkaline the sample is.
ph.meaning: Lower pH means a more acidic sample. Higher pH means a more alkaline sample.

ec.what: Electrical conductivity describes how readily the sample conducts electricity.
ec.meaning: With the same unit and method, higher conductivity usually means more dissolved salts.

noRange: There are fewer than two distinct values in the same unit to compare.
